analogy.rationale: The annotated antiviral targets (ADK, ENPP1, IMPDH1/2, NT5C2, ADA) are purine-metabolism enzymes; most human cell lines express them but the drugs' antiviral action depends on viral enzymes or high intracellular nucleotide pools, so transcriptional responses are expected to be weak. The closest reference classes are other nucleotide-synthesis inhibitors, though they act at different steps and would share only partial downstream nucleotide-stress programs.
